_doc: Everstow (self-storage) score weights. Edit here; storage.py reads this file on every run. Top-level weights sum to 100. Demand sub-weights sum to the demand weight; visibility parts are shares of the visibility weight. Factor set follows the demand drivers a broker CIM uses (1/3/5-mi population and households, household income, renter share, growth, SF per capita supply, traffic/visibility).
